svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. SHS 50 x 50 x 3 mm, 760 mm long, 6 mm end caps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top plate: 100 x 160 x 10 mm, centred on top, its 160 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across the bar. Two 18 mm holes on the plate's long centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line, 50 mm each side of the bar centre line (100 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tip lugs: 60 x 70 x 10 mm plates hanging under each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred 40 mm in from the end, in line with the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14 mm hole 25 mm above the lug's bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm fillet welds all round; galvanise.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It hangs under the main beam on two M16 bolts through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sleeves at 400 and 500 mm (or 300 and 400 for a calf).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bolts pass plate and sleeves together by hand.
